local_proxy.identity: CPU and BLE share owner task/object/descriptor counters and physical bytes/CRC. Receipt token is not a second object.

authority.retirement_rule: WORKSTATION_SINGLE_BLE_RECORDING rejects the R00 APB window, omits u_recording and ties owner8 subclient0 idle. Keep these retirements; the C recording_service header also contains the separate physical BLE-data API, which must remain.
authority.reset: Observer reset sets sticky fence; it cannot restart same-boot object/task counters. Raw transport faults remain quarantined until common reset; reconnect retires the transfer lease while preserving object/task/counter facts.

coupling_points.details: get_object advertises 48000 and 16384; external START and local_submit both reject limit >16384.
Physical fact MMIO rate at 0x24 is hardcoded 48000; epoch at0x28 is zero.
EXTERNAL_RAW_STORE initial guard rejects CAPACITY_FRAMES>16384; object_bytes, CRC and fetch use actual recorded frame counters.
Initial guard rejects capacity>16384. Fetch offset/frame arithmetic and 8KiB cache are separate from bulk capacity; raising a limit alone has not been validated.
Raw instance capacity16384; initial assertions require BLE64KiB/16384-native-word range; source_allowed rejects44.1k and mismatched current rate/epoch.
Default capacity16384; source continuity currently checks sequential frame IDs and maximum4ms sample age.
Policy metadata is still format1/48k/16384 frames. CPU business ownership supersedes historical RTL-owner metadata; do not copy old ownership wording.
Recording total reservation1MiB, CPU64KiB and BLE64KiB suballocations; map and guards must change explicitly for a new long recorder.

ddr.unit_authority: rtl/ddr_address_map.vh: native app_addr counts 32-bit DQ words, not bytes. One256-bit BL8 beat=32bytes=8 native words=8 stereoPCM16 frames.
ddr.native_owner8: workstation_recording_ddr_client_queues with RECORDING_ENABLE=1 routes recording_valid to native client8. Existing top recording_owner8 mux separates retired R00 subclient0 and BLE raw subclient1; native_accept[8], not local slot_ready, advances committed prefix. CPU memory client2 is a different client.

target60s.explanation: 11MiB=11534336 bytes fits 60s/48k if recorder begins at aligned allocation base. Keeping current BLE base offset64KiB leaves only11468800 bytes in11MiB;12 granules or explicit relocation is required. No new address range is allocated by this audit.

download.policy: Bound recording write/capture service first; bound each download read and defer CNN. Measure actual service intervals and combined DDR timing before choosing queue depths.

ddr.no_remote_memory: All storage above must be physically W-local in a new selected W role; W has no direct access to M DDR, USB, TF, HDMI or DAC.

minimal_selected_role_path: Add a new explicit task3 W media/storage profile; do not mutate task2 W21 or accepted profiles.

Use a headless cooperative root pumping Classic/HCI/SBC/PCM plus the same C ble_business_owner; expose bounded CPU/M control adapters to local_submit/poll/facts without restoring framebuffer UI or a second recorder.
Select maintained CPU-owner GATT/physical data engine with EXTERNAL_PCM=1, EXTERNAL_SEAL_PROTOCOL=1, EXTERNAL_RAW_STORE=1, SINGLE_BLE_RECORDING=1; retain one H5/HCI credit owner.

Create minimal W-local memory composition reusing recording-aware native queues with RECORDING_ENABLE=1, preserving owner6 Delay and real BIST/authority/native bridge; no video dependency. Leave R00subclient0 and CPU memory client2 inactive unless separately required.

Initially bind one bounded, trusted final-output PCM stream and preserve 48k short-object semantics to prove source/capture/native commit/CPU-created-BLE-download identity. Extend long capacity and format/rate facts as an explicit new verified stage.

After measured LCD pin/electrical/throughput/RTT/congestion acceptance, feed M final completed serial-output PCM via session/rate/epoch/sequence/error-checked bounded receive queues. M never waits for record/download/CNN; overflow or gap fails object integrity and drains accepted prefix.

Extend capacity/map/guards/C+physical facts/protocol compatibility coherently for60s and later44.1k; test full actual native window, byte/word conversions, partial BL8, object immutable format, STOP/CLEAR/download/replay/reset/timeout and CNN/media contention.

link_admission_gaps.burst_pacing: Existing engine processes four CRC bytes after capture; a PCM valid during nonzero capture_state is a source failure. LCD receive bursts need a bounded decoder/queue with at least five control-clock edges between accepted PCM valids; direct one-frame-per-clock bursts are incompatible.
link_admission_gaps.continuity: Current HCI wrapper sequence+1 and4ms age are local-frame assumptions. New remote source wrapper must explicitly validate link session/rate/epoch, sequence wrap policy, duplicate/drop, packet CRC and timeout; do not reset sample_seen on reconnect to conceal a gap in an active recording.
link_admission_gaps.bluetooth_budget: Native UART8E1 at nominal921600 permits at most921600/11=83781.8B/s per direction before protocol/radio overhead. It cannot carry uncompressed48k stereo16 at192000B/s. Compressed or control-only use still requires physical throughput/jitter/latency evidence.
